output.diagnosis: spec_error: DWELL without max_speed counts any presence as stay. Counterexample has 0ms still but 1.835s transit >1.5s so PASSes while truth is FAIL. 'stay' needs near-stopped time below belt speed ~0.118. Prior strict-speed +1500/1100ms patches fragment on jitter/1-3s windowing so 1067-1267ms still labelled PASS fail to accumulate continuous dwell.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample: 0ms still <800ms -> FAIL fixed. Drive-through at belt speed ~0.118 >0.08 not counted -> FAIL. Brief_stop with 1067-1600ms still can accumulate ~800ms continuous despite windowing/fragmentation -> PASS, removing 4 regressions.
proposals.rationale: 'stay' means nearly still, not transit. 0.08 is below belt 0.1178-0.1180 to reject drive-through but above strict stopped to tolerate jitter, and 800ms preserves 1.5s intent with tolerance for speed-window loss and split stops while staying far above 0.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample FAIL (0<700). 1067ms+ still PASS with more margin for fragmentation; strict 0.05 more robust to slow drive-throughs counted as stopped.
proposals.rationale: Strict stopped definition with lower dwell to compensate windowing loss: requires true stop, separates 0ms drive-through from 1000ms+ brief stops.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample FAIL. 1200ms+ still PASS if jitter <0.10; retains higher 1000ms closer to 1.5s text.
proposals.rationale: Max permissible stillness just below belt speed to maximize jitter tolerance while still rejecting belt transit, with 1000ms as compromise between 1.5s text and observed 1067ms PASS labels.
